engineHost.description: User engine host to execute the UPDATE statement against.

engineName.description: Optional engine name to send as the Firebolt engine query parameter.

database.description: Optional Firebolt database to execute the UPDATE statement in.

tableAlias.description: Optional alias for the target table.

setClause.description: The UPDATE SET clause, for example status = 'archived', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.

fromClause.description: Optional FROM clause contents to join other tables into the UPDATE statement.

whereClause.description: Optional WHERE clause to restrict which rows are updated.

settingsClause.description: Optional WITH settings clause contents for query settings overrides.

rows.description: Number of rows returned in the data payload.
